authority.scope: Continue the director-requested deep source research and appearance regeneration; self-review is not director acceptance.

approvalEvidence.scope: Rev5 MT-101 completed appearance only; comparative review acceptance, not production integration, gameplay, or exact geometry.

finding: The official cover remains the overall anchor. Rev5 preserves the steep cabin, curved shells, broad wheels, open chassis, rear drill cup/collar and docked spacecraft while restoring the full prominent horizontal Bionicle Zamor launcher above the cabin, with its open oval rear frame, dense center and forked front jaws visibly separate from the drill. One low outer wing plate is visible; the source requires its far-side pair, but this raster does not prove that occluded plate.
